label: Coeliac
notes: Medical profile. Hides items with a cross-contamination risk for gluten.

label: Gluten-free (non-coeliac)
notes: Lifestyle profile. Excludes explicit gluten but allows 'may contain' risks.

label: Halal
notes: This profile only filters out explicitly non-halal ingredients (pork and alcohol). True Halal compliance requires an explicit certification checkbox on the meat sourced by the restaurant, which cannot be derived purely from ingredient names.

label: Kosher
notes: Filters out inherent non-kosher items like pork and shellfish. It cannot express the prohibition of mixing meat and dairy in the same dish, nor can it verify kosher slaughter certification.

label: Dairy-free (milk allergy)
notes: Medical profile. Excludes the legal 'milk' allergen and hides cross-contamination risks.

label: Lactose intolerant
notes: Excludes the 'lactose' group (e.g., milk, cream, soft cheeses) but permits hard cheeses and butter, which belong to the 'milk' allergen group but contain negligible lactose.

label: Nut-free
notes: Medical profile covering both peanuts and tree nuts, hiding cross-contamination risks.

label: Low-FODMAP (onion/garlic)
notes: Specifically targets the alliums group (onions, garlic, leeks, shallots).
